_comment: Every rule fails: REL-001 non-semver version, REL-002 tests failing, REL-003 coverage < 80, REL-004 critical/high vulns, REL-005 unsigned provenance (and buildPlatform missing), REL-006 invalid targetEnvironment, REL-007 production without approvals. Decision is DENY because all four critical rules (REL-001/002/004/007) trip release-gate; the three advisory rules (REL-003/005/006) are also reported as failures.
